Aria - Product: @channel quick announcement: we're opening the Private/VPC Compliance Readiness bundle for FedRAMP & SOC2 readiness. Rolling to GA customers next quarter. Summary and tiny checklist below. :loudspeaker:

Maya - Eng-Compliance: what does the bundle include?

Aria - Product: TL;DR: hardened on-prem image with FIPS-compatible crypto option, audit-log export hooks, configurable telemetry opt-in, and a compliance assessment tool that scans cluster config against our checklist. Customers can request a readiness review.

Owen - Legal: note: FedRAMP customers will require a signed attestation and an SLA amendment. I'll prepare a one-page addendum template.

Raj - Customer Success: we'll need a playbook + migration concierge for high-touch accounts. Recommend offering a free 2-week readiness review during the pilot.

zoe.sales: flagging pricing for the add-on; need SKU for quotes.

infra-bot: feature flag "private.compliance_bundle_v1" enabled in staging at 2026-05-02T18:40Z.

Aria - Product: short checklist (owners + dates):
- Eng-Compliance (Maya) -> GA-ready image + FIPS toggle -> due 2026-06-01
- Legal (Owen) -> addendum + customer T&Cs -> due 2026-05-20
- CS (Raj) -> pilot playbook + readiness review offer -> due 2026-05-25
- Sales (zoe.sales) -> SKU + enablement -> due 2026-05-22

Maya - Eng-Compliance: opening repo and will post RFC this afternoon.

Aria - Product: we'll announce externally after internal enablement 2026-05-30. If you have compliance customers to include in pilot, DM Raj. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
